points.description: States that the equalization tank balances/evens out fluctuating flows or concentrations (e.g., smooths variations in wastewater quantity or strength before treatment).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says it stores or holds wastewater without mentioning balancing/evening out variations.

points.description: Gives at least one further role: assists self-neutralization (pH balancing), or reduces the effect of periodic slug/shock discharges from batch processes.
points.partial_credit: Half if the idea is only hinted at, e.g., 'reduces shock loads' stated vaguely or 'mixes the waste'.

rubric.notes: Full marks: the student says the tank balances/evens out variations in flow or concentration, and adds one more role (neutralization or damping slug discharges). Give part marks if only the balancing idea is given (1 mark) or the answer is vague. Give 0 for unrelated answers such as sedimentation or disinfection. Wrong extra remarks are ignored unless they contradict the central idea.
